name: form-field
title: Form Field
description: A smart form field wrapper with built-in label, hint, error, and react-hook-form integration. Props-driven or compound mode. Uses namespace exports: FormField.Root, FormField.Label, FormField.Hint, FormField.Error.

migration.guide: v3 adds automatic react-hook-form integration. Pass a `name` prop to auto-read errors from RHF's FormProvider context — no more manual `error={errors.x?.message}` or `hasError={!!errors.x}`. FormField.Root now auto-injects `hasError`, `disabled`, and `id` into direct children via cloneElement. Adds `react-hook-form` as a dependency. All v2 usage (manual error/hasError props) remains fully backward compatible.

docs.lead: A smart form field wrapper with built-in label, hint, error, and react-hook-form integration. Pass a `name` prop inside a FormProvider to auto-resolve errors — or use manual props for full control.
docs.usage:
import * as FormField from "@/components/ui/form-field"

// Automatic mode (with FormProvider)
<FormField.Root name="email" label="Email Address" required hint="This is a hint text.">
  <Input.Composed placeholder="hello@example.com" {...register('email')} />
</FormField.Root>

// Manual mode (without FormProvider)
<FormField.Root label="Email Address" error={error} hint="This is a hint text.">
  <Input.Composed placeholder="hello@example.com" />
</FormField.Root>

examples.title: Demo
examples.description: Props-driven form fields with label, hint, and various input types.
examples.code:
<FormField.Root
  label="Email Address"
  htmlFor="email"
  required
  labelSub="(Required)"
  labelInfo="We'll use this to contact you."
  hint="This is a hint text to help user."
>
  <Input.Composed id="email" leadingIcon={RiMailLine} placeholder="hello@example.com" />
</FormField.Root>

examples.title: With Error
examples.description: Form field with error state. Error replaces hint and auto-sets hasError.
examples.code:
<FormField.Root
  label="Email Address"
  htmlFor="email"
  required
  hint="This is a hint text."
  error="Please enter a valid email address."
>
  <Input.Composed id="email" leadingIcon={RiMailLine} />
</FormField.Root>

examples.title: Disabled
examples.description: Disabled form field. Disabled state auto-flows to children, label, and hint.
examples.code:
<FormField.Root
  label="Email Address"
  htmlFor="email"
  required
  hint="This is a hint text."
  disabled
>
  <Input.Composed id="email" leadingIcon={RiMailLine} />
</FormField.Root>

examples.title: Compound Mode
examples.description: Full control using sub-components. FormField.Label and FormField.Hint auto-read hasError/disabled from context.
examples.code:
<FormField.Root htmlFor="email" hasError>
  <FormField.Label required sub="(Required)">
    Email Address
  </FormField.Label>
  <Input.Root hasError>
    <Input.Wrapper>
      <Input.Icon as={RiMailLine} />
      <Input.Input id="email" placeholder="hello@example.com" />
    </Input.Wrapper>
  </Input.Root>
  <FormField.Error>Please enter a valid email address.</FormField.Error>
</FormField.Root>

examples.title: Form Validation
examples.description: Complete sign-up form with automatic react-hook-form integration. Wrap with FormProvider and pass `name` — errors, hasError, disabled, and id are resolved automatically.
examples.code:
const methods = useForm({ resolver: zodResolver(schema), mode: 'onTouched' });

<FormProvider {...methods}>
  <form onSubmit={methods.handleSubmit(onSubmit)}>
    <FormField.Root name="email" label="Email" required>
      <Input.Composed
        leadingIcon={RiMailLine}
        placeholder="hello@example.com"
        {...methods.register('email')}
      />
    </FormField.Root>
  </form>
</FormProvider>

api.name: FormField.Root
api.description: The root form field container. Auto-resolves errors from react-hook-form when `name` is provided inside a FormProvider. Auto-injects `hasError`, `disabled`, and `id` into direct children.

props.name: name
props.description: Field name for react-hook-form integration. When inside a FormProvider, auto-reads errors from form state. Also used as the default `htmlFor`/`id`.

props.name: label
props.description: Label text. When provided, renders a composed Label automatically.

props.name: htmlFor
props.description: Links label to input via htmlFor/id. Defaults to `name` when not provided.

props.name: labelClassName
props.description: Additional className to override or extend the label styling

props.name: labelSubParens
props.description: Whether to wrap labelSub in parentheses (defaults to true in Label)

props.name: labelInfo
props.description: Info tooltip content rendered as Label.Info

props.name: hint
props.description: Hint text rendered below children. Hidden when error is present.

props.name: error
props.description: Error message. Overrides auto-resolved RHF error when provided.

props.name: hasError
props.description: Error state. Auto-set when error is present (manual or RHF-resolved).

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disabled state. Auto-injected into direct children, label, and hint.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional className to override or extend styling

api.name: FormField.Label
api.description: Composed label that auto-reads disabled and htmlFor from FormField context.

api.name: FormField.Hint
api.description: Composed hint that auto-reads hasError and disabled from FormField context.

props.name: icon
props.description: Custom icon component. Defaults to built-in info circle.

api.name: FormField.Error
api.description: Error message display with error styling. Returns null when children is falsy.

api.name: useFormField
api.description: Hook to access FormField context (hasError, disabled, id, name) from custom child components.
